messages:
incident-bot: Pager - SEV2: GPU queue growth in gcp-us-central1. autoscaler failing with quota errors. observed 4.5x baseline queue length. paging oncall.

sre-oncall: ack. jumping in. first quick check: are we hitting project GPU quota or regional limit?

alex_chang: grabbing metrics. looks like nodepool-create calls are returning 403 quotaExceeded from GCE API.

maya: confirmed. quota error message: "Quotas exceeded for resource 'GPUS'". autoscaler attempts to add 12 nodes, 0 created.

ops-bot: Detect: queue_length > 2000 for 10m. throttle_rate increased. routing fallback to low-priority planned.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce non-urgent batch traffic 2) route new requests to eu-west1 fallback 3) scale down low-priority pools 4) open cloud support case for quota bump. starting 1 & 3 now.

nicole: executing policy to pause background embeddings jobs (tag=background). will patch autoscale policy to ignore background pools.

eng-runtime: deploying short-term routing change (canary) to send 30% of new requests to eu-west1. will monitor error rates.

alex_chang: running quick kubectl to evict low-priority pods:
```bash
kubectl get pods -l priority=low -n inference | xargs kubectl delete pod --grace-period=0 --force
```

maya: cloud support case opened (GCP support case 123456789). requested quota increase for A100 GPUs in us-central1. added justification: production incident, short-term request.

customer-success: flagging top affected customers. patching status page: "Some requests may see higher latency or reduced throughput for customers pinned to us-central1. We are routing new requests to other regions where possible."

ops-manager: confirm we have capacity in other regions for critical customers?

eng-runtime: eu-west1 has spare capacity for embeddings and generation at lower concurrency. latency will be ~30-80ms higher. we'll only route customer routes that opt-in or aren't pinned.

sre-oncall: Maya — can you attempt a manual node create to confirm it's quota error and not IAM?

maya: manual create fails with same 403. stack trace: 
```json
{"error":"quotaExceeded","details":"GPUS per project per region exceeded"}
```

ops-bot: Alert: autoscaler backoff triggered at 1790001245. next retry in 30s (exponential).

sre-oncall: switching to mitigation mode: 1) keep routing changes 2) drain and move critical customer jobs to eu-west1 3) throttle new batch ingestion by 70% 4) start costless fallback to CPU-only for low-latency interactive requests for a tiny subset.

alex_chang: implementing CPU fallback for routes: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"cpu-small","percent":5}
```

customer-success: drafting customer message for affected SLAs. will share.

nicole: background jobs paused. reclaiming ~8 GPUs. queue length dropped ~18% after pausing.

eng-runtime: can we hot-add spare GPUs from dedicated pool? ops-manager: do we have reserved capacity in us-central1?

ops-manager: we have 4 reserved GPUs in dedicated, but they are committed to customers A/B. negotiating now to borrow 2 for emergency.

sre-oncall: Alex — please run a script to move hot requests off the stalled nodegroups. Provide commands used.

alex_chang: running: 
```bash
# cordon old nodepool
kubectl cordon nodepool-gpu-01
# create ephemeral nodes in eu-west1
provider-cli create-nodepool --region=eu-west1 --gpu-type=a100 --count=6
```

incident-bot: Update: GCP case 123456789 assigned to Tier2 at 1790001400. ETA 2 hours.

maya: cloud support escalated to quota team. they asked for exact request rate histogram and justification. uploaded.

sre-oncall: Quick customer impact summary for the handbook: 
- Impact: Increased latency and reduced throughput for workloads pinned to gcp-us-central1.
- Scope: ~12% of total requests failover; top 5 customers saw latency spikes and queueing.
- Status: routing partial failover active, background jobs paused, quota request in flight.

customer-success: pushing proactive emails to top 3 customers. adding recommended mitigations (allow cross-region, increase timeouts).

ops-bot: Metrics snapshot at 1790001500: queue_length=1670 (was 4500), error_rate=4.2% -> 0.9% after routing change.

eng-runtime: rolling a small config update to reduce batch size from 32->16 to lower GPU memory pressure on remainders.

nicole: confirmed reclaimed 2 GPUs from reserved dedicated capacity. deployed to us-central1 as stopgap. queue length dropped another 12%.

ops-manager: still watch for quota bump. if not approved we should plan a controlled degradation: reduce per-tenant concurrency by 30% and keep critical routes only.

sre-oncall: preparing for handoff. On-call rotation ends in 45m. summary to next oncall: actions taken, ongoing cloud case id 123456789, routing changes in place (30% to eu-west1), background jobs paused, dedicated GPUs lent temporarily.

eng-runtime: PR to automate route rollback if eu-west1 errors > 5% merged and deployed.

alex_chang: manual attempt to increase quota via console failed since console shows limits locked. cloud support says only quota team can modify.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager silence scheduled for noise suppression at 1790001680 for the next 10m.

sre-oncall: Handoff to night-oncall @nicole in 30m. Nicole — key things: monitor queue, ensure background stays paused, keep routing canary until cloud confirms.

nicole: ack. will take over. adding runbook checklist to thread.

ops-bot: Update: GCP quota bump approved for +10 A100 GPUs in us-central1 at 1790001780 (temporary).

maya: applying changes: autoscaler now able to create nodes. creating 8 nodes now.

alex_chang: observed node creations succeed. pods scheduling, GPU allocs healthy. queue draining.

ops-bot: Metrics at 1790001850: queue_length=220, error_rate=0.3%, p95 latency back within SLO for routed requests.

customer-success: status page updated: "Incident mitigated — traffic restored for most customers. We continue monitoring."

sre-oncall: closing summary before handoff: root cause: regional GPU quota limits hit during sustained traffic spike, autoscaler retried and backoff made scale-up stall. mitigations: pause background, route to eu-west1, borrow reserved GPUs, open cloud case. action items: 1) request permanent quota increase 2) add cross-region auto-failover for pinned customers 3) add alerting for quota-exhaustion errors (403) specifically 4) postmortem.

nicole: taking over monitoring and running post-incident checklist. will draft postmortem doc.

eng-runtime: will follow up with a PR to surface quota exhaustion metrics in the console and add a synthetic test that attempts node create weekly.

ops-manager: good job everyone. please collect logs, timestamps, and customer impact notes for the postmortem.

sre-oncall: incident resolved for now. handing off to Nicole.

nicole: ack. will run through fast postmortem draft and ping eng-product for prioritization.

ops-bot: Incident thread closed at 1790001900 (status: mitigated).
